sentences.en: Forest conservation is an important issue all over the world.

sentences.en: Conservation is a state of harmony between men and land.
sentences.zh: 保护是一种人与土地之间的和谐状态。

sentences.en: The organization plays a principal role in wildlife conservation.
sentences.zh: 该组织在野生动物保护方面扮演着主要角色。
